Reference / runtime/time

runtime/time#

The native layer under testing/time, time/clock: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under testing/time, time/clock: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Portable clock boundary. Clock readings are integral nanoseconds supplied by the active runtime. Waiting accepts canonical arbitrary-precision decimal text so the stdlib never narrows Duration through the host integer width.

Public API#

native wall_clock#

native wall_clock() is int

The wall clock, in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch.

native monotonic_clock#

native monotonic_clock() is int

The monotonic clock, in nanoseconds.

native clock_domain#

native clock_domain(fresh is bool) is string

Identity allocation does not read or change a clock.

native sleep_nanoseconds#

Sleeps for duration nanoseconds without blocking other tasks.
